iamops.refusal.AUTHORITY_NOT_IN_FORCE: You do not hold the operations authority this action needs, or it is not in force today. Ask its owner to check the period and the scope.
iamops.refusal.FIELD_MISSING: A required value is missing. Fill in the marked field below and send again.
iamops.refusal.FIELD_INVALID: One of the values sent is not valid. Correct the marked field below and send again.
iamops.refusal.DEVICE_CREDENTIAL_REVOKED: This device has been revoked and cannot act again, though what it recorded is kept. Pair it again with a new code.
iamops.refusal.PREMISES_RELATIONSHIP_END: That premises relationship has ended, so the device cannot be reinstated. Pair a device under the current premises relationship.
iamops.refusal.EVIDENCE_RETENTION_IN_FOR: The device has been revoked. Recorded evidence cannot be removed or changed, so it stays as it is.
iam07.title: Device register
iam07.meta: {n} devices: {a} active, {s} suspended, {r} revoked. As of {u}.
iam07.note.SUSPENDED: Operations can reinstate a suspended device.
iam07.note.REVOKED: A revoked device never returns. Its evidence stays attributed to it.
iam07.sortNote: Active first, then suspended, then revoked. Within each group, the most recent use first.
iam07.filteredText: {n} devices are in the register. Remove a filter to see more.
iam07.errText: The device register could not be loaded. Quote the reference below to support.
iam08.byEvent: RightOne, automatically, when the event took effect
iam08.revokedNote: A revoked device never returns. To use it again, the premises pairs it with a new code.
iam08.relWhy: The premises relationship this device was paired under has ended.
iam08.authWhy: You do not hold the operations authority this action needs.
iam08.nfText: The address does not lead to a device you can open.
iam08.sText: The device stops at its next request. Operations can reinstate it, and its evidence is kept.
iam08.rText: The device can act again from its next request.
iam08.vText: Revocation cannot be undone. The {n} accepted evidence periods are kept.
iam08.reasonMissing: Enter a reason and send again.
iam08.causeMissing: Enter a cause and send again.
iam08.effectiveInvalid: The effective time cannot be before the pairing. Correct it and send it again.
iam08.effectiveHelp: Not before the pairing time, {p}. Defaults to now.
iam08.doneText.suspend: The device stops at its next request.
iam08.doneText.reinstate: The device can act again from its next request.
iam08.doneRevokeText: The {n} accepted evidence periods are kept.
iam08.errText: The device could not be loaded. Quote the reference below to support.
